title: owo-lib issue #507: [1.21.1 NeoForge] NeoForge 21.1.262 breaks NetworkRegistryMixin (RETURN ordinal = 3): "Sided Packet Codec has not been unpacked", every player kicked on join
licence: GitHub issue thread: user-generated content under the GitHub Terms of Service; the repo licence (MIT) does not cover issue text
text:
[issue by oggioni2004]
**Versions:** owo-lib 0.12.15.5-beta.1+1.21 (NeoForge), Accessories 1.1.0-beta.53+1.21.1, Minecraft 1.21.1, NeoForge **21.1.262** (works on 21.1.259)

**What happens:** on NeoForge 21.1.262, every player is disconnected while joining a dedicated server:
```
Internal Exception: io.netty.handler.codec.EncoderException: Failed to encode packet 'clientbound/minecraft:custom_payload'
Failed encoding custom payload accessories:main: [owo] Sided Packet Codec has not been unpacked
```

**Cause:** `io.wispforest.owo.mixin.neoforge.NetworkRegistryMixin#owo$unpackSidedCodec` targets `NetworkRegistry.getCodec` with `@At(value = "RETURN", ordinal = 3)`.

NeoForge commit neoforged/NeoForge@0e98dad, shipped in 21.1.262 ("Enforce network setup payload directions and decoding limits"), added a new early `return null` inside the `BUILTIN_PAYLOADS` branch of that method. The RETURN ordinals in 21.1.262 are now:

| ordinal | return |
|---|---|
| 0 | `return null` (new: serverbound modded setup payloads) |
| 1 | `return BUILTIN_PAYLOADS.get(id)` |
| 2 | `return null` (no registration) |
| 3 | `return null` (flow mismatch) ← owo now modifies this one |
| 4 | `return registration.codec()` ← should be modified |
| 5 | `return null` (wrong phase) |

As a result, the `SidedPacketCodec` is never unpacked, and its `encode`/`decode` always throw. This breaks Accessories and every mod using owo networking on NeoForge 1.21.1. Hosts that auto-update the loader (for example Aternos) can't pin 21.1.259, so those servers are currently unjoinable.

**Suggested fix:** drop the ordinal so the unpacking applies to every return. The `instanceof` check already makes it a no-op for the other returns, and it works on both old and new NeoForge builds:

```java
@ModifyReturnValue(method = "getCodec", at = @At("RETURN"))
private static PacketCodec<? super PacketByteBuf, ? extends CustomPayload> owo$unpackSidedCodec(PacketCodec<? super PacketByteBuf, ? extends CustomPayload> original, @Local(argsOnly = true) NetworkSide flow) {
    if (original instanceof SidedPacketCodec<?> sidedPacketCodec) {
        original = (PacketCodec<? super PacketByteBuf, ? extends CustomPayload>) sidedPacketCodec.getCodec(flow);
    }
    return original;
}
```

(`original` can be `null` on the other returns. `instanceof` handles that.)

I also reported this to NeoForge: neoforged/NeoForge#3652. Forgified Fabric API has the same ordinal-3 pattern in its own `NetworkRegistryMixin`, so the NeoForge side may adjust as well. A release of owo-lib with this change would fix it regardless.

[comment by oggioni2004 (none)]
Update: NeoForge closed neoforged/NeoForge#3652 as **not planned / "not us"**. Their position is that `NetworkRegistry` is `@ApiStatus.Internal`, so mixins into it are at the mod's own risk. They won't restore the old RETURN layout, so the fix has to come from owo-lib.

Right now, every NeoForge 1.21.1 server running Accessories (and everything built on it, for example Cobblemon: Mega Showdown, Legendary Monuments and ZA Megas) kicks all players on join as soon as it runs 21.1.262. Hosts that auto-update the loader, like Aternos, can't stay on 21.1.259.

The one-line change from the issue (`@At("RETURN")` without `ordinal = 3`; the `instanceof` check keeps it a no-op on the other returns) works on both old and new NeoForge builds. A new `0.12.15.x` neo release with it would unblock a lot of servers. I'm happy to open a PR against `1.21-Neo` if that helps. @Dragon-Seeker
